instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Rank rows by liters within each truck_id
output: SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY truck_id ORDER BY liters DESC) FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Dense rank of rows by liters
output: SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY liters DESC) FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Row number per truck_id ordered by filled_at
output: SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY truck_id ORDER BY filled_at) FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Running total of liters ordered by filled_at
output: SELECT *, SUM(liters) OVER (ORDER BY filled_at) FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Running total of liters per truck_id
output: SELECT *, SUM(liters) OVER (PARTITION BY truck_id ORDER BY filled_at) FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Average of liters over all rows
output: SELECT *, AVG(liters) OVER () FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Previous liters value (lag) per truck_id
output: SELECT *, LAG(liters, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY truck_id ORDER BY filled_at) FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Next liters value (lead) per truck_id
output: SELECT *, LEAD(liters, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY truck_id ORDER BY filled_at) FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Maximum liters per truck_id across all rows
output: SELECT *, MAX(liters) OVER (PARTITION BY truck_id) FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Minimum liters per truck_id
output: SELECT *, MIN(liters) OVER (PARTITION BY truck_id) FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Moving average window of 3 rows per truck_id
output: SELECT *, AVG(liters) OVER (PARTITION BY truck_id ORDER BY filled_at ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Window frame from first row to current per truck_id
output: SELECT *, SUM(liters) OVER (PARTITION BY truck_id ORDER BY filled_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
First value of liters per truck_id
output: SELECT *, FIRST_VALUE(liters) OVER (PARTITION BY truck_id ORDER BY filled_at) FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Last value of liters per truck_id across full partition
output: SELECT *, LAST_VALUE(liters) OVER (PARTITION BY truck_id ORDER BY filled_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Percent rank of liters
output: SELECT *, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY liters) FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Cumulative distribution of liters
output: SELECT *, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY liters) FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Quartile bucket using NTILE
output: SELECT *, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY liters) FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Difference of liters from its group max
output: SELECT truck_id, liters, liters - MAX(liters) OVER (PARTITION BY truck_id) AS diff FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Rank of liters with ties allowed to skip
output: SELECT truck_id, liters, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY liters DESC) FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Sliding window of total over preceding 5 rows
output: SELECT *, SUM(liters) OVER (ORDER BY filled_at ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Running count per truck_id
output: SELECT *, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY truck_id ORDER BY filled_at) FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Top 2 by liters within each truck_id using ROW_NUMBER
output: SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY truck_id ORDER BY liters DESC) rn FROM fuelings) x WHERE rn <= 2;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Nth value of liters within partition
output: SELECT *, NTH_VALUE(liters, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY truck_id ORDER BY filled_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Expressed ratio of liters to group total
output: SELECT truck_id, liters, liters / SUM(liters) OVER (PARTITION BY truck_id) AS ratio FROM fuelings;

instruction:
Schema: fuelings(truck_id, liters, filled_at)
Window with custom unbounded following frame
output: SELECT *, SUM(liters) OVER (PARTITION BY truck_id ORDER BY filled_at ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM fuelings;
